strings.privacy.title: Sɛbɛn tanga
strings.privacy.description: Cogo min na pdffusion bɛ i ka fayiluw minɛ: tɔgɔ tɛ, sɛbɛn tɛ mara, ad tɛ ni kibaruw bɛɛ ka tanga.
strings.privacy.intro: pdffusion labɛnna walasa i ka sɛbɛnw ka to i ta ye. Yan bɛ mɛn na, cogo min na a bɛ baara kɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: I ka fayiluw
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: U bɛ ci (HTTPS) ni tanga ye, ka baara kɛ yɛrɛma, ka bɔ yen sɔrɔminɛ. Fayilu belebelew bɛ taa yɔrɔ bon na ni tɔgɔ wɛrɛ ye ka bɔ yen baara ban na; yɔrɔkɔrɔ bɛ fɛn bɛɛ bɔ awa ti 24 kɔnɔ.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni tɛ, kibaruw tɛ
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion tɛ tɔgɔ sɛbɛnni ɲini, email tɛ, kadi tɛ. I ka sɛbɛnw tɛ kalan, tɛ lajɛ, tɛ taa ni ɲɛn, tɛ fana baara kɛ ni inteligansi ye.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Minɛn lajɛli
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: An bɛ taama lajɛ ka tɛ tɔgɔ don ni cookie tɛ (Vercel Web Analytics) walasa ka minɛn minw ka ɲi ka dɔn. Ad tɛ, taama lajɛ tɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie kelen dɔrɔn: a bɛ kan min sugandinnen don lajɛ.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Bɔyɔrɔ
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: A bɛ Paris server na Vercel fɛ; Word, Excel ni PowerPoint yɛlɛmali bɛ Frankfurt Render fɛ. Minɛn ninw bɛ fayiluw minɛ yɛlɛmali waati dɔrɔn.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Sɔrɔli
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ɲiningali wala kɔnɔko? I bɛ se ka se an na baara yɔrɔ na:
strings.legal.terms.title: Baarakɛcogo cɛya
strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion tɛ wari sɔrɔ mɔgɔ bɛɛ bolo, ko baarakɛlaw ani kɔngɔnbaw fana bɛ se ka a baarakɛ. I ka kɔpiw bɛ to i ta ye: fɛn si tɛ kɔlɔsili wala ka mara.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Nin cɛya bɛ i ka baarakɛcogo kɔlɔsi pdffusion la. A sɔgɔra kɔnɔna tiɲɛn na ka da cogo la. Ni i bɛ baarakɛ n'a ye, i bɛ a sɔn.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Mun bɛ pdffusion yira
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: Mikailou Cedric Toure ye pdffusion dilan ka a yira, baarakɛla min bɛ New Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Sɔrɔli bɛ mɔgɔ bɛɛ bolo ka baarakɛ
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdffusion tɛ wari sɔrɔ, sɔrɔli tɛ a la ani waati dan tɛ a la mɔgɔ bɛɛ bolo: mɔgɔ kelen kelen w, kalandenw, kalandenmɔgɔw, baarakɛla, jamu wɛrɛw, kɔngɔnbaw ani kɔngɔn kɔnɔnaw, Canada ani jamana wɛrɛw bɛɛ. Baara si tɛ wari sɔrɔ baara la, sabu a tɛ yen. I ka kɔpiw bɛ to i ta ye: sɛbɛn tɛ a la wala pdffusion tɔgɔ tɛ yen.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: I ka kɔpiw bɛɛ, ko kɔnɔnakɛlaw fana
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: I bɛ se ka baarakɛ ni kɔpi cogo bɛɛ ye, ko kɔnɔnakɛlaw fana, sabu pdffusion tɛ i ka kɔpiw kalan, kɔlɔsi, mara wala ka a di mɔgɔ wɛrɛ ma: a bɛ baarakɛ ka wolo ka bɔ a la. I bɛ to i ka kɔpiw tigi ye, ani i tɛ nɔ n'i bɛ se ka baarakɛ n'a ye.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Sɔrɔli gbakuru ani i ka sɔrɔli i yɛrɛ ka serivɛrɛw la
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: pdffusion gbakuru bɛ bɔ MIT cɛya kɔnɔ. I bɛ se ka a kalan, ka a kɔlɔsi, ka a don i yɛrɛ ka serivɛrɛw la (kɔnɔna kɛnɛ la internet tɛ min na), ka a yɛlɛma ka a di mɔgɔ wɛrɛ ma, n'i yara ka kɔpi kɔlɔsi sɛbɛn ani cɛya kɔnɔna to yen.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Baarakɛli kɛcogo
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: I tɛ se ka pdffusion baarakɛ ko jugu kɔnɔ, ka baarakɛli tiɲɛ (kɔpiw caman yeli sɔrɔli la, donni kɔnɔ), wala ka a cɛya bɔ baarakɛli la. Kɔpi caman ani teliya bɛ baarakɛ kɔlɔsi mɔgɔ bɛɛ bolo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Baarakɛli sɔrɔli
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdffusion tɛ wari sɔrɔ. A bɛ se ka yɛlɛma, ka dan sɔrɔ labɛncogo kama wala ka ban. I ka kɔpi sɔrɔli to i bolo tuma bɛɛ: pdffusion tɛ kɔpi si mara.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Hɛɛrɛ ani kɔnɔnakɛli
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Serivɛrɛ bɛ di “cogo min na”, hɛɛrɛ tɛ a la. Sariyaw sɔrɔli la, baarakɛla tɛ kɔnɔnakɛli sɔrɔ kɔpi tiɲɛni, kɔpi kɛnɛbali wala yɛlɛmali tiɲɛni kama. I ka kɔpiw kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ ni i bɛ baarakɛ n'a ye ko baaba la.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Hakili la fɛn
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: pdffusion tɔgɔ, a jɛn ani kɔnɔna sɛbɛn bɛ baarakɛla ta ye; gbakuru bɛ MIT cɛya kɔnɔ cogo min fɔra san fɛ. Tɔgɔ minnu fɔra (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) bɛ a latigiw ta ye.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Baarakɛli sariya
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Nin cɛya bɛ kɔlɔsi ni New Brunswick Jamana sariya ani Canada kɔnɔna sariya ye. New Brunswick kɔtɛw bɛ baarakɛli sɔrɔ, ani i ka jamana sariya bɛ se ka i dɛmɛ cogo min na kɔngɔnbaba ye.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Yɛlɛmaliw
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Nin cɛya bɛ se ka yɛlɛma. Tile min bɛ kɔnɛ fɔlɔ a bɛ kɔpi sɛbɛn yira; yɛlɛmali bɛ baarakɛ tuma min bɛ kɔfɛ.
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].title: Kɛnɛ
strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: Sɔntɔn nin cɛya la? Sɛbɛn sɔrɔ i ka baarakɛnɔnfɛɛrɛ la:
strings.legal.security.title: Hɛɛrɛ ani kɔpiw
strings.legal.security.description: Mun bɛ kɛ i ka kɔpiw la pdffusion la: baarakɛli ka wolo ka bɔ a la, kɔlɔsili tɛ a la, bɔli teliya la, hɛɛrɛ, Eropa kɔnɔna, ani i bɛ se ka a don i yɛrɛ ka serivɛrɛw la.
strings.legal.security.intro: Mun bɛ kɛ i ka kɔpiw la, u bɛ baarakɛ yɔrɔ min ani cogo min na u bɛ kɔlɔsi: a fɔra nɔgɔman na, mɔgɔ bɛɛ ani baarakɛbɔniw bɛ se ka a faamu.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Kɔpi si tɛ mara
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: I ka kɔpiw bɛ baarakɛ ka wolo ka bɔ a la, ka bɔ a la teliya la sɔrɔli sɔrɔli sɔrɔ ka wolo wala ka yeli sɔrɔ. Kɔpi tɛ yen, kɔlɔsi tɛ yen, kibaru tɛ yen. Tile bɛɛ bɛnni bɛ kɔpi sɔrɔli kɛ ka kɔpi tɛmɛnnenw bɔ a la sabu tile sɔfɛ.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Kɔlɔsili tɛ yen
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Mɔgɔ si tɛ i ka kɔpiw kalan. U tɛ kɔlɔsi, kɔlɔsi kɔfɛ, sɔrɔla wala ka baarakɛ n'u ye ka kɔnɔnakɛli lakika kalan. pdffusion tɛ ni kɔpi ye, wariw tɛ yen, ani baarakɛla nɔ tɛ yen.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Hɛɛrɛ
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Kɔnɛ bɛɛ hɛɛrɛna (HTTPS) ani serivɛrɛ bɛ hɛɛrɛ sɔrɔ yeli bɛɛ (HSTS). Lakika baarakɛminɛn bɛ PDF hɛɛrɛ ni AES-256 ye; i ka kafigɛ tɛ mara abada.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: I ka kɔpiw bɛ baarakɛ yɔrɔ min
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Serivɛrɛ, PDF ani jas baarakɛminɛn: Vercel, Paris kɔnɔna yɔrɔ (France, Eropa Jɛya). Word, Excel ani PowerPoint yɛlɛmali: Render, Frankfurt (Germany, Eropa Jɛya). Kɔpi minnu ka bon ka tɛmɛ 4 MB la: Vercel Blob kɔlɔsi sɔrɔli, tɔgɔ nɔgɔman na, bɔli kɔfɛ.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Hɛɛrɛ lakika
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Hɛɛrɛ kɔlɔsi sɛbɛnw (HSTS, serivɛrɛ nɔ tɛnɛni kɔpi wɛrɛw la, kɔpi kɛnɛbali lakika), kɔpi tɔgɔ sɔrɔli tɛ se ka dɔn, ani yɛlɛmali serivɛrɛ min bɛ sɔn ka kafigɛ sɔrɔ kelenpe. Gbakuru yɛlɛmali bɛ kɔlɔsi fɔlɔ (sɔntɔnw, cɛya) kɔfɛ kɛnɛ la.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Kɔnɔnakɛli ani sariya
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdffusion sɔrɔla New Brunswick kɔnɔ ani a bɛ Canada sariya kɔlɔsi (PIPEDA). A tɛ baarakɛli kibaru sɔrɔ i ka baarakɛlaw la: kɔpi tɛ yen, kɔfɛ sɛbɛn tɛ yen, kɔlɔsi cookie tɛ yen. A dilanna cogo kelen na ni Eropa GDPR ani Quebec Sariya 25 ye: kɔlɔsili dɔgɔya, kɔfɛ baarakɛ tɛ yen, bɔli kɔfɛ.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Kɔngɔnba minnu ni sariya ka gele
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Ni i ka sariya bɛ se ka kɔpiw ci serivɛrɛ kɔfɛ, pdffusion don i yɛrɛ ka serivɛrɛw la. Baarakɛminɛn bɛɛ tɛ wari sɔrɔ, a gbakuru bɛ kɛnɛ la ani a bɛ baarakɛ n'internet tɛ yen: kɔpi si tɛ bɔ i ka kɔnɔna la. Donni tilɛn bɛ baarakɛnɔnfɛɛrɛ la.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Kɛnɛya
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Gbakuru bɛɛ bɛ kɛnɛ la: i ka hɛɛrɛ baarakɛlaw bɛ se ka nin fɔtaw bɛɛ kɔlɔsi.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Hɛɛrɛ tiɲɛni fɔ
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: I hakili la ko i ka hɛɛrɛ tiɲɛni sɔrɔ? Fɔ a ma kɔnɔnakɛli na “Hɛɛrɛ” tɔgɔla baarakɛnɔnfɛɛrɛ la:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Baarakɛli
strings.legal.accessibility.description: pdffusion baarakɛli fɔta: WCAG 2.2 level AA ta, labɛn minnu bɛ yen, dɔnniya dan ani cogo min bɛ se ka hɛɛrɛ tiɲɛni fɔ.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Mɔgɔ bɛɛ bɛna se ka pdffusion baarakɛ, fɔ mɔgɔ numanw wala minnu gɛlɛn u ka yɛlɛ, mɔgɔ mɛnbaw wala minnu gɛlɛn u ka mɛn, wala minnu ni kɔnɔna wala baarakɛli gɛlɛn bɛ.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Ta cɛya
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdffusion bɛ se ka bɛn Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, W3C jamana cɛya ma. Nin level bɛ Canada Jamana kɔlɔsi sɔrɔ, Eropa cɛya EN 301 549 ani Section 508 United States, minnu bɛ tɛmɛ WCAG 2.0 wala 2.1 level AA la.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Bɛnni tɔgɔ
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion bɛ bɛn dɔɔni WCAG 2.2 level AA ma: dɔnniya dan fɔra kɔfɛ. Nin fɔta bɛ kɔlɔsili kɔnɔna la min kɛra October 2, 2026, ka baarakɛminɛnw baarakɛ (axe, Lighthouse) ani bolola kɔlɔsili (keyboard, kɔlɔsi, zoom, fɔtaw). Kɔlɔsili kɔfɛ tɛ kɛ fɔlɔ.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Mun bɛ yen
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Kɔnɛ bɛɛ bɛ baarakɛ ni keyboard ye, ni “Tagɔ kɛ kɔnɔku” sɔrɔli bɛ yen ani yira kɛnɛ la baarakɛminɛn kan. Kɔlɔsi kɔlɔsi bɛ se at least 4.5:1.
